description: Presidential Secretariat -  The Public Security Ordinance was approved by a resolution of Parliament
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the parliamentary approval of a proclamation made by the President under the Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40), bringing Part II of the Ordinance into operation. This content deals specifically with the activation of legal/regulatory provisions under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
